title: controllers.json — controller registry contract
description: Doc 07 F-2/F-7: the registry of entities that actually hold chokepoints — a state pole, a specific creditor, a consortium, a regulatory regime, a firm. Sixth contract, referenced by controller_id from edges.json and events.json rather than asserted inline beside them. Schema-enforced rules here are structural only (shape, enums, patterns); pole derivation, direction derivation, consortium membership rules, reversal resolution, and controller_id resolution are cross-file business rules and live in validate.py's named checks (doc 07 §4), not here.

controllerEntry.description: Doc 07 F-7 registry shape. pole_override is the only asserted pole field; everywhere else pole is derived (validate.py check_pole_derivation) from control_jurisdiction via pole_map.json.

control_jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of ultimate control. Load-bearing — this, not incorporation, is what pole and direction derive from.

incorporation.description: Jurisdiction of incorporation. Descriptive only (doc 07 F-7 rule 4): informs a p_jurisdiction reviewer prompt when it differs from control_jurisdiction, never changes direction_derived.

pole_override.description: The only place a pole is an analytic assertion rather than a derivation. Requires override_rationale (validate.py check_pole_derivation).

members.description: Consortium-only (validate.py check_consortium_members). Malaysia is exposed to the consortium, not to each member.
